cases.testName: native Todo telemetry is advisory, deterministic, and revision-bound
cases.expected: Native Todo planning is revision-bound telemetry only: it creates no completion evidence, does not increment host progress, and identical plan rewrites do not churn Goal state.

cases.testName: native Todo writes bind to the active Goal revision without becoming progress or evidence
cases.expected: A todowrite call started under an older Goal revision or before a pause cannot attach planning state to the newer/non-active Goal.

cases.testName: broad Goal continuation coordinates native Todos without making them completion evidence
cases.expected: Broad Goals use native Todos as a living execution plan while Todo completion, assistant suggestions, and nice-to-haves cannot widen scope or prove Goal completion.

cases.testName: current unfinished Todo plan vetoes completion without becoming evidence
cases.expected: A current native Todo plan with pending or in-progress work blocks Goal completion, while completed Todo state creates no evidence and stale Todo telemetry cannot veto a newer Goal revision.
